subject: MAP: onramp sprint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA & retention clarifications
body:
From: Caroline Li <caroline@finact.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@finact.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and a couple quick clarifications on security gates

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending the updated MAP. I pulled in procurement so they can see the timeline too. A couple of items the security team asked us to confirm before we greenlight the sprint:

- SOC 2 evidence: do we need the full control matrix or will the evidence index suffice for acceptance?
- SIG/CAIQ: is an in-person walkthrough required or is the questionnaire + follow-up video meeting acceptable?
- DPA redline: procurement asked about the data deletion window — can you confirm Redwood's default retention and whether there is a 90-day escrow option?

I attached the MAP you sent (I renamed it FinAct_MAP_v2.xlsx) and our procurement checklist. We're aiming for a contract signature by 8/20 if the security lane is clear.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Caroline
Director, Security & Risk
FinAct

---

On Mon, 02 Aug 2027 at 10:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Caroline Li <caroline@finact.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@finact.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and a couple quick clarifications on security gates

Thanks Caroline — good questions. Short answers up front:

1) SOC 2 evidence: for MAP acceptance we accept the evidence index (PDF) plus the SOC 2 report as a gating artifact. Full control artifacts (runbooks/screenshots) are only requested during a deeper security audit.

2) SIG/CAIQ: questionnaire + recorded walkthrough is acceptable for the MAP sprint. If you still want an on-site or live deep-dive, we can schedule a 60-minute session with our security engineer.

3) DPA & retention: Redwood default retention for evaluation keys/data is 30 days after account deactivation; we can offer a 90-day escrow/archival window as an addendum for enterprise contracts. We will suggest explicit language in the DPA redline — please confirm whether procurement needs the escrow to be opt-in or mandatory.

Attaching the SOC2-evidence-index.pdf and a short excerpt from our DPA for procurement to review.

Next steps:
- Jonas, can you confirm the SOC 2 evidence index is sufficient for acceptance and flag any must-have items?
- Karthik, can you add a note in HubSpot about the optional 90-day escrow addendum and proposed pricing impact?

Caroline — once you confirm escrow preference, I'll update the MAP timeline and share a DocuSign packet for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf, FinAct_MAP_v2.xlsx

---

On Tue, 03 Aug 2027 at 14:28 Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and a couple quick clarifications on security gates

Marissa — quick confirmation from security: the evidence index looks complete for an acceptance gate. A couple small asks to call out in the MAP:

- Confirmed SOC 2 report (latest 12-month report) attached to the index. If FinAct needs control-level artifacts, we'll coordinate a scoped evidence pull (takes ~3 business days).
- For SIG/CAIQ we require a completed questionnaire; walkthrough recording is fine for acceptance but please include timecodes for any high-risk controls we talk through (network segmentation, KMS/HSM usage, and data residency).
- DPA retention: 30-day default is standard; 90-day escrow can be appended as an optional addendum (we recommend opt-in with a fee unless this is an enterprise procurement requirement).

I'll add a short paragraph to the MAP under "Security Acceptance" clarifying the above. Karthik — happy to sync and refine the MAP language before Marissa sends.

Jonas Weber
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

---

On Sun, 08 Aug 2027 at 16:42 Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Caroline Li <caroline@finact.com>, Procurement Team <procure@finact.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and a couple quick clarifications on security gates

Caroline — thanks for the fast feedback and for looping procurement. Per Jonas' note and our internal policy, here is the updated acceptance language we'll add to the MAP and the DPA redline:

- MAP Security Acceptance: Acceptance for the MAP sprint will be satisfied by submission of the SOC 2 report and the SOC2-evidence-index.pdf. If FinAct requests control-level artifacts, Redwood will produce a scoped evidence set within 3 business days.
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed questionnaire + recorded walkthrough accepted for MAP gating. Redwood will provide a recorded walkthrough and flag discussion points; if FinAct requests an on-site review, that will be scheduled as a separate consult.
- DPA Retention: Default evaluation retention is 30 days post-deactivation. Redwood can include an optional 90-day escrow addendum; Procurement to confirm whether this must be included in the base contract.

I have updated the MAP (FinAct_MAP_v3.xlsx) and pushed the file to the shared drive link below. I've also created a DocuSign package with the current redline — Procurement, please review and let me know if you want the 90-day escrow to be mandatory. If we have sign-off by 8/13, we stay on track for contract signature by 8/20 and production onboarding in September.

Links & artifacts:
https://drive.google.com/finact/MAP_v2  (FinAct_MAP_v3.xlsx will be in the same folder)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/58623
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/secure/transaction/DsId-9981

Action items:
- Caroline: confirm escrow preference (opt-in vs mandatory) — due 8/10
- Procurement: review DocuSign redline and confirm any DPA carveouts — due 8/12
- Karthik: update deal record with the optional addendum and expected price delta.

 Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if it's easier — otherwise we'll proceed on the dates above.

Best,
Marissa
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinAct_MAP_v3.xlsx (in drive), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf
